mapper.select: SELECT l.secure_link_id,l.consent_request_id,l.link_status,LEAST(l.expires_at,r.expires_at) expires_at,r.request_status FROM seal.secure_link l JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) WHERE l.token_hmac=#{tokenHmac}

SELECT l.secure_link_id,l.consent_request_id,l.link_status,LEAST(l.expires_at,r.expires_at) expires_at,r.request_status FROM seal.secure_link l JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) WHERE l.token_hmac=#{tokenHmac} FOR UPDATE OF l,r
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.secure_link SET link_status='ACCESSED',accessed_at=COALESCE(accessed_at,#{now}),version_no=version_no+1 WHERE secure_link_id=#{linkId} AND link_status='ISSUED'
mapper.sql: SELECT s.public_consent_session_id,s.consent_request_id,s.secure_link_id,s.session_status,LEAST(s.expires_at,r.expires_at) expires_at,snap.snapshot_json::text snapshot_json,snap.snapshot_hash,r.request_status FROM seal.public_consent_session s JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN seal.consent_request_snapshot snap ON snap.consent_request_snapshot_id=r.snapshot_id
mapper.select: WHERE s.flow_hmac=#{flowHmac} FOR UPDATE OF s,r

SELECT i.consent_request_item_id,i.item_order,i.item_title,i.required,i.purpose_text,i.retention_text,i.refusal_notice,COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(d.item_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.item_order) FROM seal.consent_request_item_data d WHERE d.consent_request_item_id=i.consent_request_item_id),'') personal_data_items,COALESCE(i.third_party_recipient,'') third_party_recipient FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN seal.consent_request_item i ON i.consent_request_snapshot_id=r.snapshot_id WHERE r.consent_request_id=#{requestId} ORDER BY i.item_order
SELECT consent_response_id,response_status,TRUE existing,submitted_at FROM seal.consent_response WHERE consent_request_id=#{requestId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.consent_request SET request_status='COMPLETED',updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE consent_request_id=#{requestId} AND request_status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE seal.secure_link SET link_status='COMPLETED',completed_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE secure_link_id=#{linkId} AND link_status IN('ISSUED','ACCESSED')
UPDATE seal.public_consent_session SET session_status='EXPIRED',flow_hmac=NULL,flow_destroyed_at=#{now} WHERE consent_request_id=#{requestId} AND session_status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE seal.public_consent_session SET session_status='EXPIRED',flow_hmac=NULL,flow_destroyed_at=#{now} WHERE public_consent_session_id=#{sessionId} AND session_status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at<=#{now}

UPDATE seal.public_consent_session SET session_status='EXPIRED',flow_hmac=NULL,flow_destroyed_at=#{now} WHERE consent_request_id=#{requestId} AND public_consent_session_id<>#{sessionId} AND session_status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE seal.public_consent_session SET session_status='COMPLETED',completed_at=#{now} WHERE public_consent_session_id=#{sessionId} AND session_status='ACTIVE'
